summary.text: Rodney Pierce is a Democratic state representative from North Carolina House District 27 who assumed office on January 1, 2025, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
The General Assembly lists his occupation as historian and consultant and his district as Halifax, Northampton and Warren counties.

paragraphs.text: Pierce was born in Landover, Maryland, according to Ballotpedia.
He earned an associate degree from Halifax Community College in 2010 and a bachelor's degree from North Carolina Wesleyan College in 2012.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a lifelong resident of Halifax County and a graduate of Halifax County Schools, and that he spent nearly a decade as a classroom teacher before serving in the General Assembly.
He also said he works as a historian and has helped secure historical markers recognizing stories and people from eastern North Carolina.
Pierce said in the survey that he was elected to the North Carolina House in 2024 and has focused on public education, health care, rural economic development, infrastructure and public safety.
He serves on the House Appropriations, Homeland Security and Military and Veterans Affairs, and Insurance committees and on the Appropriations Subcommittee on General Government.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026.
